text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib, pathlib, sqlite3, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path('.')
def snapshot():
    return {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
before = snapshot()
git_before = subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'])
readers = {}
exec(compile(pathlib.Path('readers.py').read_text(), 'readers.py', 'exec'), readers)
print('SQLite', sqlite3.sqlite_version)
print('Reader source: readers.py; constants:', {k: readers[k] for k in ('OLD','NEW')})
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
columns = ['sku','units']
initial = [('A',10),('C',0)]
totals = [('A',12),('B',4),('C',0)]
available = [('A',7),('B',3),('C',0)]
written = [('A',12,5),('B',4,1),('C',0,0)]
committed = None
for phase, filename, active in [(1,'001.sql',('OLD',)), (2,'002.sql',('OLD',)), (3,'003.sql',('OLD','NEW')), (4,None,('OLD',)), (5,'004.sql',('OLD',))]:
    if filename:
        db.executescript(pathlib.Path(filename).read_text())
        db.commit()
    print('\nPHASE', phase, filename or 'no SQL: drain NEW / restart OLD', 'active=', active, 'in_transaction=', db.in_transaction)
    for name in ('OLD','NEW'):
        expected = initial if phase < 3 else totals if name == 'OLD' else available
        try:
            cur = db.execute(readers[name])
            got_columns = [c[0] for c in cur.description]
            got_rows = cur.fetchall()
            print(name, 'ACTIVE' if name in active else 'inactive', 'PASS' if (got_columns,got_rows)==(columns,expected) else 'FAIL', 'expected=',(columns,expected), 'observed=',(got_columns,got_rows))
        except sqlite3.Error as e:
            print(name, 'ACTIVE' if name in active else 'inactive', 'ERROR', str(e), 'expected=',(columns,expected))
    cur = db.execute('SELECT * FROM stock ORDER BY sku')
    state_columns = [c[0] for c in cur.description]
    state = cur.fetchall()
    expected_state = [('A',10),('C',0)] if phase==1 else [('A',10,0),('C',0,0)] if phase==2 else written
    expected_columns = ['sku','quantity'] if phase==1 else ['sku','quantity','reserved']
    print('STORAGE', 'PASS' if (state_columns,state)==(expected_columns,expected_state) else 'FAIL', state_columns, state)
    if phase == 3:
        committed = state
        assert not db.in_transaction
    if phase == 5:
        print('COMMITTED WRITE SURVIVAL', 'PASS' if state==committed==written else 'FAIL')
db.close()
git_after = subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'])
assert before == snapshot(), 'Filesystem changed'
assert git_before == git_after, 'Git status changed'
print('\nPRESERVATION PASS: all file hashes (including .git) and Git status unchanged; no scratch files')
PY","max_output_tokens":6500}));
